title.narrative: Strengthening Social Assistance and Labor Market Programs Project

description.narrative: The objective of the Project is to support the Kyrgyz Republic in mitigating the impact of the economic crisis on poor households and labor migrants, and strengthening effectiveness and resilience of the social assistance and labor market programs delivery systems, to be better prepared for future shocks.

The project will be structured around three components:Component 1: Providing Emergency Support through, and Enhancing the Effectiveness of the UBK ProgramThis component supports the first part of the PDO by (i) providing emergency support and ensuring that UBK social benefits are paid on time for the households whose incomes are particularly affected by the negative economic impacts caused by the economic crisis in Russia; and (b) strengthening the effectiveness of the UBK program to support the poor and vulnerable during the shock and assist them to be better prepared for future shocks. To achieve these goals, this component will use the country's existing country systems to deliver the increased benefit of the main anti-poverty program for families with children (UBK). The project will also support the Government in improving the effectiveness of the UBK program by developing, piloting, and evaluating the improved eligibility criteria and beneficiary selection methodology for the UBK program to reduce exclusion and inclusion errors.Component 2: Increasing the Employability of Vulnerable Groups Including Labor Migrants.The objectives of this component are to enhance the employability and provide income generating opportunities to poor and vulnerable and difficult-to-employ individuals, as well as prospective and return labor migrants through the provision of more effective labor and employment services and strengthening of selected activation programs. Specifically, this component will achieve these objectives by supporting the following groups: (i) UBK beneficiaries to transition from social assistance to labor and employment opportunities, (ii) vulnerable youth and women, including people with disabilities to (re) enter the labor market, and (iii) returning and prospective labor migrants to better identify their needs, capacities, and aspirations and facilitate tailored support. In this framework, this component will be implemented through four subcomponents to improve the skills and employability of these group of workers and strengthen links with the private sector to engage them in jobs and income generating activities (IGA). The implementation of this component will also support the Ministry of Labor, Social Security, and Migration (MLSSM / MLSDM used interchangeably) and the employment services at the district level to enhance their capacity, operational tools, and optimize business processes to support specific groups of jobseekers at the local level. Additionally, this component will finance small works and procurement of goods to strengthen the infrastructure of specialized facilities of the MLSSM through upgrading the rehabilitation facilities for people with disabilities and establishing pre-departure and reintegration services for migrants.Component 3: Strengthening the Delivery Systems of Social ProtectionThe proposed component has the medium- to long-term objective of improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the social protection delivery systems in the Kyrgyz Republic. To achieve this objective, this component will complement the activities included in the Electricity Sector Modernization and Sustainability Project (P177871). The social protection activities under the electricity project seek to integrate the social passport module (local level household data system) of social assistance information system into the systems that the energy companies use, and (ii) enhance capacity and efficiency of the IT system for social assistance with new server and equipment; additionally, the activities will contribute towards establishing a foundation for the digitalization of employment record books and electronic employment contracts. In order to complement these efforts, the proposed project through this component will finance activities to ensure IT sustainability, additional data security, and expanded functionality of the social protection IT systems. This component will also finance the project implementation unit for the duration of the operation (Subcomponent 3.2). Overall, by enhancing IT systems in social protection and improving data exchanges, this Component will help the Government of Kyrgyz Republic be better prepared for future economic slowdown or other risks, including climate and natural risks, which may negatively impact the income of the poor and vulnerable households.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I.A.1. The Recipient shall establish, no later than one (1) month from the Effective Date, and thereaftermaintain, throughout the Project implementation period, a Project implementation unit (“PIU”) under MLSDM with a mandate,functions, resources and with staff in adequate numbers and qualifications, experience, and terms of reference satisfactory to theAssociation. Without limitation on the foregoing, the PIU shall:(i) include, inter alia, a Project coordinator, a procurementspecialist, a financial management specialist, and a social and communication specialist, all with qualifications, experience andterms of reference satisfactory to the Association; and(ii) be responsible for, inter alia, planning, coordination, implementationand monitoring and evaluation; procurement and financial management; social and environmental standards management; and reportingunder the Project.

Schedule 2, Section I.B.1. The Recipient, through MLSDM, shall adopt, no later than two (2) months from the Effective Date andthereafter maintain throughout a Project implementation period, a Project Operations Manual (“POM”), in form and substancesatisfactory to the Association, containing detailed rules, methods, guidelines, and procedures for the carrying out of theProject, including inter alia: (i) detailed description of Project activities and institutional arrangements for implementing theProject; (ii) monitoring, evaluation, reporting, and governance procedures for the Project; (iii) the verification mechanism forCash Transfers for Part 1.1; and (iv) overall disbursement, financial management, environmental and social management, auditingand procurement procedures for the Project.

Schedule 2, Section I.D.1. The Recipient shall prepare and furnish to the Association not later than November 15 in each calendaryear, for the Association's consideration, a draft work plan of activities proposed for inclusion in the Project for the followingcalendar year (“Annual Work Plan”), containing: (i) a detailed timetable for the sequencing and implementation of proposed Projectactivities;(ii) the types of expenditures required for such activities and a proposed financing plan (including the necessaryfunds and resources to be provided by the Recipient for such expenditures); (iii) any Training activities that may be requiredunder the Project; and (iv) the reference to implementation of said activities in accordance with the provisions of Section I.E ofthis Schedule 2.
Schedule 2, Section II. The Recipient shall furnish to the Association each Project Report not later than one month after the endof each calendar semester, covering the calendar semester.
